title: Await asynchronous syntax completion; do not bless blank transient code blocks as goldens

missing_seam.explanation: The async highlight contract (request -> HighlightRequest, complete(HighlightRequest, HighlightedText)) is a bridge model with NO live call site. `pub mod highlight` is exported (crates/opentui-bridge/src/lib.rs:8) but the CLI never imports it: `grep -rn 'highlight::|HighlightService|HighlightedText|StyledRun|frame_text|styled_runs' crates/cli/src` returns zero matches. The only HighlightedText constructors are HighlightedText::new (highlight.rs:394) and the #[cfg(test)] helper doc() (highlight.rs:964). There is no host loop that issues HighlightRequest and applies Completion. Because no async highlight is ever in flight, the live code fence has no 'blank transient' state to await: it renders synchronously as sanitized plain text.

why_no_live_consumer: LIVE code render is synchronous plain text: every code/tab row path calls sanitize_code (native_view_chat.rs:1273) then expand_code_tabs (:1280) and emits a single full-row CODE|CODE_BLOCK span (native_view_chat.rs:1802-1805). No tokenizer, no per-token style, no async state.

The only live style sink for chat rows is ChatRunSpan.flags consumed at tui_entry.rs:4860-4875/4900-4907 and resolved by markdown_run_color (tui_entry.rs:4195). markdown_run_color maps flags to MarkdownPalette fields only (markdown.code/heading/strong/...). It has NO branch for per-token syntax roles; the SyntaxPalette (native_theme_runtime.rs:840, populated :706-716 from syntaxComment/syntaxKeyword/syntaxFunction/...) is never consulted on the live paint path.

Theme::syntax_rules (native_theme_runtime.rs:965) has zero non-test callers; its two test call sites (:3692/:3725 within the module test region starting at the #[cfg(test)] marker :2725, and the standalone #[cfg(test)] block at :4272) confirm it is a test-only table.

No style-table sink on the checked renderer ABI (THEME-14): SafeRenderer::draw_text_styled (safe_renderer.rs:906) takes explicit fg/bg/attributes with no syntax-style table parameter, and the CLI only uses Renderer/Rgba (tui_entry.rs:89). There is nowhere live to install or paint a syntax token color.

No highlighter producer exists in-workspace: `grep -rln 'syntect|tree-sitter|tree_sitter'` over crates/*.toml and *.rs returns nothing; Cargo.lock contains 0 matches for syntect/tree-sitter; there are no grammar (*.scm) or highlight-query assets. Upstream drives this through tree-sitter via waitForHighlightedFrame/highlightingDone (SKILL.md:19,21; message-parts.tsx:182).
required_producer: A live async syntax engine + on-completion contract wired into the running TUI, equivalent to upstream's shared tree-sitter worker (message-parts.tsx:182 draws no text until the worker replies). This requires BOTH (a) a grammar/tokenizer producer and (b) a live consumer loop that requests highlight, waits for completion, and repaints.
A per-token style sink: new ChatRunSpan flags for syntax roles plus a markdown_run_color/SyntaxPalette branch, and a renderer ABI that can carry token styles (currently absent, THEME-14).
bounded_highlighter_assessment: NOT bounded. Checked honestly for a small in-workspace TS/JSON tokenizer or an existing syntect dependency: neither exists (Cargo.lock 0 matches; no *.scm/query assets; no tokenizing producer feeding live rows). A hand-rolled bounded tokenizer would still need three missing pieces: (1) a live async request/complete host loop to satisfy 'await asynchronous syntax completion', (2) new ChatRunSpan syntax-role flags, and (3) a SyntaxPalette lookup on the live paint path (markdown_run_color) or a renderer style-table (absent per THEME-14). That is a subsystem, not a bounded wiring edit, and it would still not match upstream tree-sitter completion semantics.
blocking_reason: A new helper/model method with no live caller is REJECTED. HighlightService::complete/request, HighlightedText and Theme::syntax_rules already exist as test-only models with no live consumer; there is no async highlighter to await and no per-token style sink. Wiring one requires a new async syntax subsystem, not a bounded patch.
focused_test_plan: n/a (blocked). Existing coverage is test-only inside crates/opentui-bridge/src/highlight.rs (doc()/stale-result tests around :964-1230) and crates/cli/src/native_theme_runtime.rs (#[cfg(test)] region :2725+ :3692/3830). None reaches the live render.
